raw_response: The figure presents a grouped bar chart comparing the percentages of aluminum, copper, and nickel in Germany and the EU across three years: 2021, 2022, and 2023. The horizontal axis represents the materials (aluminum, copper, and nickel), while the vertical axis displays percentages ranging from 0 to 30, with tick marks at intervals of 5. Each material is represented by three bars, corresponding to the years 2021, 2022, and 2023, colored blue, purple, and gray, respectively. For aluminum, the values are 3.6%, 2.7%, and 1.0% in Germany and 3.2%, 1.7%, and 1.3% in the EU. Copper values are 11.3%, 8.3%, and 2.2% in Germany and 4.4%, 5.1%, and 1.3% in the EU. Nickel values are 24.7%, 25.1%, and 11.4% in Germany and 23.3%, 24.3%, and 14.6% in the EU. The bars for each material are arranged side-by-side for easy comparison across the years and between Germany and the EU.
